reviewQuotes.name: Mohammad M.
reviewQuotes.quote: It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say I’ve learned more about traditional Hadith sciences in this one year than I had over several years accessing books without dedicated mentorship within this niche.

reviewQuotes.name: Mizan A.
reviewQuotes.quote: The level in which Mufti Dawood Saheb breaks down sentences in this course for both fields of grammar, i haven't witnessed that in any other course.

reviewQuotes.name: Muhammad R.
reviewQuotes.quote: Sh. Omer has thoroughly researched the lessons before presenting them and managed to explain certain complex points in very simple words.

reviewQuotes.name: Arshid Bashir B.
reviewQuotes.quote: I have listened to introduction to muwatta from other shyookh but this introduction opened new doors of understanding for me.

reviewQuotes.name: Tajrian I.
reviewQuotes.quote: Wish I took this course earlier. It was amazing learning the theory and rules of Nahw and applying them as well as recognizing them in texts.

reviewQuotes.name: Mohammed A.
reviewQuotes.quote: I particularly appreciate how every term in the science of Hadith is followed by a practical example, making the content extremely applicable.

reviewQuotes.name: Shehryar D.
reviewQuotes.quote: Despite the text of the book being so difficult, its explained and broken down by the Shaikh in such an excellent manner that everything is understandable.

reviewQuotes.name: Mustafa H.
reviewQuotes.quote: The way the rulings were broken down and made digestible for the students while also providing an in-depth understanding of the framework of the madhab really brought out the sweetness of this book.

reviewQuotes.name: Amir P.
reviewQuotes.quote: Many students often struggle to fully grasp the concepts in Usul al-Fiqh … but Shaikh is able to break down and explain each concept in a beautiful manner.

reviewQuotes.name: Hussain M.
reviewQuotes.quote: It has not only helped me enhance my Arabic skills but also given me a deeper and more comprehensive understanding of the lineage of the Messenger ﷺ.
